newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cenbank 3rd 1-wk repo drains funds at 45 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cenbank 3rd 1-wk repo drains funds at 45 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank said on Tuesday that it accepted all bids at the maximum set yield of 45 percent in its third one-week reverse repo operation of the day to drain liquidity from the market.
No volume of accepted transactions was released.
The first one-week tender on Tuesday had an average accepted yield of 44.43 percent, while no bids were accepted in the second operation, the CNB said.
